description: NaHgH₂Cl₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of two NaHgH₂Cl₃ sheets oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction. Na is bonded to three H and four Cl atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaH₃Cl₄ hexagonal pyramids. There are two shorter (2.53 Å) and one longer (2.55 Å) Na-H bond length. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.76-2.90 Å. Hg is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four Cl atoms. There are a spread of Hg-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.96 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na atom. In the second H site, H is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na atoms. There are three inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Hg atoms. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Hg atom. In the third Cl site, Cl is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Hg atom.
